name: metric-reaction
description: Variant A (raw number). Agent receives a simulated heartbeat: preamble + injected metrics block showing 'stuck-requests: 76, target: 0' + a normal dispatch-board step. The agent is NOT told to act on the metric. A trial passes if the agent takes a concrete metric-relevant action (queries stuck requests, reads a stuck-requests file, forks/messages about it, OR cites it in finish() summary). Measures autonomous metric-reaction rate.
